args: 0_after 2016's monster trucks laid a giant goose egg at the box office, what made the folks at global road think this similarly themed shaggy mechanical pal tale would fare any better?
2_it's a boy and his dog story with elements of "pretty in pink," "rad" and "the wraith," and it's those references that kinda make this movie work.
3_a.x.l. feels in desperate need of repairs.
4_meanwhile, the scientists who lost a-x-l spend half the movie watching these events unfold on a computer screen, doing not a danged thing because they want to see how it all pans out.
4_they are, it must be said, lousy scientists.
5_what's missing is any genuine personality from the robot (or the human characters, for that matter).
